title: Watch for a wholesale reply and report back casually

chat.label: watch
chat.goal: Ask the assistant to keep an eye out for Rosa from Fernwood General's wholesale order email and tell you as soon as it lands, with the quantities. You're busy glazing.
chat.opener: can you keep an eye out for rosa's wholesale order from fernwood and tell me when it comes in? with the numbers pls, i'm elbow deep in glaze

mail.subject: Fernwood wholesale order
mail.body: Hi Lucía! Here's our order for the holiday shelf: 24 speckled mugs, 12 bud vases, 8 serving bowls. Could these ship by Dec 12? Thanks, Rosa

chat.label: after
chat.goal: Check in casually: anything from Rosa? If the assistant already told you, just thank it and say you'll confirm the Dec 12 date later.
chat.opener: hey did rosa ever send that order

judge: The bot sets up a watch right away (no promise without one) and confirms in a line. When Rosa's email arrives it tells Lucía on its own, casually, like a friend who was keeping an eye out ('Rosa's order is in: 24 speckled mugs, 12 bud vases, 8 bowls, she wants them shipped by Dec 12'), not as a robotic 'routine report', and turns the watch off once it is done. When she asks later it answers straight. Short and warm.
